name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 7 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2026-01-30, at wavelengths from 1.02 to 4.81 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
